title: "About Me"

Hi! I’m Joseph Lee, an MSPH candidate in Health Services Research at Emory University, graduating in May 2026 with a Certificate in Data Science.

My work sits at the intersection of health services research, data analytics, policy, and implementation. I am especially interested in using data to understand healthcare access, improve program operations, and support more practical decision-making in health systems.

<ul>

  <li>Worked with claims data, EHR data, and multi-state survey datasets</li>
  <li>Created visual summaries, dashboards, and technical briefs for applied audiences</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="about-card">

<ul>

  <li>Developed policy-focused research on autism insurance mandates and access to care</li>
  <li>Applied research evidence to inform policy, clinical, and program planning</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="about-card">

<ul>
  <li>Supported program implementation, evaluation, and operational improvement efforts at Georgia's largest safety-net hospital</li>
  <li>Managed cases for 1000+ oncology and surgery patients and their caregivers as a Board-Certified Patient Advocate</li>
  <li>Gained 3+ years of firsthand experience with payer, provider, and care coordination workflows</li>

What keeps me engaged is the space where data, operations, and policy meet. I am drawn to teams that use analytics practically and creatively to improve healthcare programming, strengthen implementation, and support better care.
